findings.evidence: examples/minilinks/app/server.py:438-440 reads complete static file into memory via f.read()
findings.recommendation: For current lightweight web assets (index.html, style.css, app.js), full memory reads are efficient. For future expansion with larger static assets, consider streaming file chunks to self.wfile using shutil.copyfileobj to optimize memory utilization.

findings.evidence: examples/minilinks/app/database.py:125 uses instr(LOWER(COALESCE(...)), ?) > 0 for case-insensitive search filtering
findings.recommendation: Using instr with lowercased values avoids SQLite LIKE wildcard escaping complications (% and _) while guaranteeing robust case-insensitive substring matching. Consider adding an index on LOWER(title) if the dataset grows significantly.

findings.evidence: examples/minilinks/web/app.js:78-87 implements safeHref and normalizeUrl to sanitize URLs and prevent javascript: URI XSS vectors
findings.recommendation: Maintain this defense-in-depth sanitization pattern alongside textContent-based DOM rendering for user-supplied strings.

findings.evidence: examples/minilinks/tests/test_api.py:583 and test_persistence.py:159 use time.sleep(1.05) to ensure second-precision updated_at timestamps advance past boundary
findings.recommendation: While time.sleep(1.05) ensures deterministic assertions on second-resolution ISO-8601 timestamps, adopting microsecond resolution (e.g. datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()) would allow removing sleeps to speed up test execution.
